title: Efficiently architecting VQAs: Expressibility--Trainability--Resources Pareto-Optimality
summary: Ansatz selection is a key factor in the performance of variational quantum algorithms (VQAs). While much of the state-of-the-art still relies on heuristic choices, an inadequate circuit structure can compromise both the expressive power and the trainability of the resulting model. Recent results have also established theoretical connections between expressibility and the onset of barren plateaus, highlighting the need for systematic criteria for ansatz selection. In this work, the ansatz is treated as a design feature to be optimized rather than a fixed block, and a design space exploration…
